## 3. Academic Publications & Research Work



### Publications



#### 1. Q-ALU (Quant Asymmetric Leaky Unit)

*A market-psychology-aware activation function with downside risk protection for high-frequency quantitative trading and deep reinforcement learning.*



- **Abstract Summary:** Q-ALU is a custom activation function engineered specifically for deep neural network architectures operating within quantitative finance and high-frequency trading (HFT) environments. Grounded in Prospect Theory, Q-ALU addresses asymmetric market behavior—where loss aversion dictates that negative returns impact trader utility and market regimes more severely than equivalent gains. By incorporating parameterized asymmetric slopes and dynamic scaling sensitive to drawdown and volatility, Q-ALU improves gradient flow and feature representations during volatile regimes and Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) policy optimization (e.g., PPO).

- **Publication Venue:** Social Science Research Network (SSRN) Working Paper Series

- **SSRN Abstract:** https://ssrn.com/abstract=7365098

- **DOI:** https://doi.org/10.2139/ssrn.7365098

- **Official Open-Source PyTorch Implementation:** https://github.com/cyclocerine/qalu-pytorch

### AI & Quantitative Finance



1. **AI Algorithmic Hedge Fund Platform**

   - **Repository:** https://github.com/cyclocerine/HedgeFund

   - **Description:** End-to-end algorithmic trading and portfolio optimization infrastructure. Employs deep reinforcement learning agents and machine learning pipelines for automated market entry/exit decisions, dynamic position sizing, and systematic backtesting.



2. **Q-ALU PyTorch Module**

   - **Repository:** https://github.com/cyclocerine/qalu-pytorch

   - **Description:** Open-source production implementation of the Q-ALU activation function for PyTorch. Includes benchmark scripts, loss curve metrics, and validation tests comparing Q-ALU against ReLU and LeakyReLU across financial time-series forecasting tasks.



3. **Stock Price & Pattern Prediction System**

   - **Repository:** https://github.com/cyclocerine/Stock-Price-Prediction

   - **Description:** Predictive machine learning pipeline focused on technical chart pattern recognition and financial market time-series analysis built with Python, Pandas, and custom neural network layers.



### Systems, Web & Applications



4. **Hospital Management System**

   - **Repository:** https://github.com/cyclocerine/HospitalManagementSystem

   - **Description:** Enterprise management platform created with Django. Streamlines healthcare workflows, patient registration, electronic health records, doctor scheduling, and billing routines.



5. **Sudoku Solver**

   - **Repository:** https://github.com/cyclocerine/Sudoku-Solver

   - **Description:** High-performance grid solver implementing backtracking and constraint satisfaction algorithms.



6. **FreeBSD Hardware Performance Monitor**

   - **Description:** Custom hardware telemetry solution. Fetches system load, memory usage, and throughput metrics from a FreeBSD host server, transmitting telemetry over a local network to an ESP8266 driving an SSD1306 OLED display.



7. **Smart Aquaculture System (IoT)**
